response.sql: WITH ds AS (SELECT s.raceId, r.circuitId, s.driverId, s.wins - COALESCE(LAG(s.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY s.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS gained FROM driverStandings s JOIN races r ON r.raceId = s.raceId), per_race AS (SELECT raceId, circuitId, AVG(gained) AS race_avg FROM ds GROUP BY raceId, circuitId), per_country AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(p.race_avg) AS avg_wins FROM per_race p JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = p.circuitId GROUP BY c.country HAVING AVG(p.race_avg) IS NOT NULL), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m1 FROM per_country), kept AS (SELECT pc.country, pc.avg_wins, b.m1 FROM per_country pc, bench b WHERE pc.avg_wins > b.m1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m2 FROM kept) SELECT k.country, k.avg_wins AS average_wins, k.avg_wins - k.m1 AS above_overall_benchmark, k.avg_wins - m2.m2 AS above_second_mean FROM kept k, m2 WHERE k.avg_wins > m2.m2

assumptions.assumption: A driver's previous round is their previous driverStandings row in the same season, ordered by races.round. The first row in a season subtracts 0.
Per-race average is over all drivers with a standings row at that race. Countries are grouped by circuits.country.
